_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Recurring Hardware Requirements Verification Documentation
summary: The Hardware Requirements Verification Documentation is used to obtain detailed plans and procedures used to demonstrate traceability to each applicable Performance Specification and Drawing Requirement.
use_relationship:
The Hardware Requirements Verification Documentation will be used to obtain detailed information on plans and procedures used to meet the specific requirements of the product in order to demonstrate traceability to each applicable Performance Specification and Drawing Requirement.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Hardware Verification Documentation shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Verification Documentation shall contain a title page specifying the following:

preparation_instructions.title: The Contractor's plans for conducting all recurrent tests
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation shall include in detail, the Contractor's plans for conducting all recurrent tests and how he plans to analyze the test results to show how the hardware items satisfy the requirements of the applicable design and performance specification(s).

preparation_instructions.title: The following information for each hardware item
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation shall include the following information for each hardware item:

children.title: Details how each design and performance specification requirement will be verified.
Identity of the assembly level at which verification will take place.
A list of the test and inspection procedure reference(s) that will be used for verification.

preparation_instructions.title: The documentation shall contain a flow diagram
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation shall contain a flow diagram that reflects the functional description and location of the manufacturing test program, including Highly Accelerated Stress Screening (HASS), within the prime Contractor's and suppliers' facilities. A block diagram portrayal of the functions that must be met to satisfy the design and performance specifications and specifies the order of testing to be performed and any dependencies on earlier testing. Identify which tests and inspections will comprise Pre-FAT or FAT category performed within the prime Contractor's facility.

preparation_instructions.title: A list of pass-thru items
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation shall contain a list of pass-thru items that describes the inspections, tests, or criteria implemented by the prime Contractor to verify satisfactory hardware design and performance to specifications.

preparation_instructions.title: The factory acceptance test (FAT) performed
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation shall include the factory acceptance test (FAT) performed and shall identify inspections, tests, and acceptance criteria performed within the prime Contractor's facility for each item listed.

preparation_instructions.title: Government test facilities
preparation_instructions.content: Government test facilities shall be identified and shall include a reference to the appropriate private party work agreement and the test availability plan, if applicable.

preparation_instructions.title: Step-by-step testing operations
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation shall include step-by-step testing operations to be performed to show how the hardware item will satisfy the requirements of the applicable design and performance specifications. All procedures shall be listed in the order in which they were performed and shall also include:

children.title: Part number of the assembly level item to be tested.

preparation_instructions.title: A summary of the each tests objective
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation shall include a summary of the each tests objective and shall identify:

children.title: A description of all the data analysis tools and techniques that will be used to interpret the data.

preparation_instructions.title: A list of all equipment to be used
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation shall include a list of all equipment to be used, including the instrumentation and recording devices, used during the test.

preparation_instructions.title: The step-by-step operator instructions and approach
preparation_instructions.content: The step-by-step operator instructions and approach used to perform each test shall be specified.
